meta.title: Rejecting a vendor already in a proposal is refused with 750

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the event groups reject participant request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot reject a vendor that is already evaluated or awarded”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Rejecting a vendor already in a proposal is refused with 750

expected.message: You cannot reject a vendor that is already evaluated or awarded
